foreignQualification.feeBasis: Online-only application; the fee table lists $70.00 for the foreign LLC's Application to Register.
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File a Statement of Information within 90 days of initial registration and every two years thereafter, and keep an agent for service of process designated.

evidence.quote: Limited Liability Companies – Foreign (Out-of-State or Out-of-Country) :: California Secretary of State
Statement of Information : Due within 90 days of initial registration and every two years thereafter. Online Only $20.00
Corporations, limited liability companies, limited partnerships, and limited liability partnerships are required by statute to designate an agent for service of process.

notes: The foreign LLC application is an online-only filing: the fee table lists it as Online Only and names no separate PDF form for it, while the rows that have paper forms name them. $70.00 is the registration fee only; the $20.00 Statement of Information fee is a separate ongoing obligation, and the agent-for-service-of-process requirement is statutory.
